data.long_meaning: Katharina is the Greek form of Catherine, derived from the Greek word 'katharos', meaning 'pure' and 'chaste'. In Christian tradition, the name is associated with Saint Catherine of Alexandria, a 4th-century martyr and saint. The name Katharina carries the meaning “Pure and Chaste” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in German, Greek. Parents who choose Katharina usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and chaste and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Katharina total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
